content:
iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra will be released next month with a brand-new A20 Pro chip; this weekend, a reputable leaker shared the expected performance improvement based on supply chain information.

The A20 Pro chip is expected to deliver an 18% performance boost and 30% greater energy efficiency

Apple will introduce its latest chip technology breakthrough at its major September event: the A20 Pro chip.

The A20 Pro will be Apple's first chip manufactured using TSMC's 2nm process. It is also rumoured to adopt the new Wafer-Level Multi-Chip Module (WMCM) packaging technology.

Based on all these innovations, we have been expecting a larger-than-usual performance leap for this year's chip.

Weibo leaker "Fixed Focus Digital" posted this weekend, stating that based on supply chain information, the A20 Pro will bring the following upgrades compared to the A19 Pro:

  • 18% performance improvement
  • 30% energy efficiency improvement

When Apple officially announces the details next month, the specifics will undoubtedly be more refined. Apple typically announces the improvements for the CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine separately.

But if these numbers hold true, it would be a fairly impressive leap. Improved energy efficiency means better battery life, while also delivering the most powerful performance ever.

Combined with the speed improvements of iOS 27 itself, the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra look set to be an exciting upgrade in terms of performance.

What are your thoughts on the rumoured performance improvements of the A20 Pro? Feel free to share your opinions in the comments section.
